name: Zero G. Academy
source: You are a talented student from Earth, who has been given a chance to study in a prestigious Zero G. Academy. However, even though you have a very high opinion of yourself, the teachers and students in this institute of learning might not consider you the supreme being, based just on your word.
translation: 你是一名来自地球的天才学生，获得了进入著名零重力学院学习的机会。然而，尽管你对自己评价极高，学院的教师和学生或许不会仅凭你的话就把你当成至高无上的存在。
